findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_commerce_radar_offer, list_premium_agent_packs · Private data: list_products, get_commerce_radar_offer, qualify_premium_buyer, quote_instant_work, paid_web_extract, paid_funding_loop, paid_funding_rates · Public sink: quote_batch_web_intelligence · Destructive: recommend_paid_tool, execute_paid_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_commerce_radar_offer, list_premium_agent_packs · Private data: list_products, get_commerce_radar_offer, qualify_premium_buyer, quote_instant_work, paid_web_extract, paid_funding_loop, paid_funding_rates · Public sink: quote_batch_web_intelligence · Destructive: recommend_paid_tool, execute_paid_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
